# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(purrr)
  library(readxl)
  library(broom)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(limma)
  library(tibble)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION", "data")
reference_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "ref_files")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results")
```

# Define Functions

## Load Data

```{r func_load}
get_metadata <- function() {
  pheno_df <- read.csv(file.path(save_dir, "linear_model", "Phenotypes.csv"))

  pheno_df
}

get_beta <- function(pheno_df) {
  # get beta values
  dnam_data <- readRDS(
    file.path(hrs_dir, "batch_corrected", "HRS_White_NHispanic_PCA.RDS")
  )
  beta_data <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam

  # Filter to samples we used for analysis
  idx <- match(pheno_df$SubjectID_Submitter, dnam_data$SubjectID_Submitter)
  beta_data <- beta_data[, idx, drop = FALSE] * 100

  beta_data
}

read_dmr_data <- function() {
  dmr_df <- read.csv(file.path(save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", "interact_DMRs.csv")) %>%
    dplyr::select("DMR", cpg = "cpgs_in_region") %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows("cpg", sep = ",")

  dmr_df
}

get_dmr_scores <- function(beta_data) {
  dmr_df <- read_dmr_data()
  beta_data <- beta_data[dmr_df$cpg, ]

  dmr_df <- limma::avereps(beta_data, ID = dmr_df$DMR)

  dmr_df
}

get_data <- function() {
  pheno_df <- get_metadata()

  beta_data <- get_beta(pheno_df)
  dmr_df <- get_dmr_scores(beta_data)

  list(pheno_df = pheno_df, dmr_df = dmr_df)
}
```

## Plot Data

```{r func_plot}
# Retain the styling and point-plus-linear-smoother layout of the original
# CpG scatter plots, without correlation tests or statistical subtitles.
plot_dmr_scatter <- function(pheno_df, dmr_values, dmr, outcome, title, y_label) {
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    dmr_value = as.numeric(dmr_values),
    outcome_value = pheno_df[[outcome]]
  )

  cor2 <- suppressWarnings(
    stats::cor.test(
      plot_df$dmr_value,
      plot_df$outcome_value,
      method = "spearman",
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  )

  ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = dmr_value, y = outcome_value)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::geom_smooth(
      method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "DMR ", dmr, "\n",
        "Spearman = ",
        sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(cor2$estimate)),
        ", p = ",
        formatC(cor2$p.value, format = "g", digits = 3)
      ),
      x = "DMR mean DNAm (beta, %)",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 5, r = 3, b = 5, l = 3, unit = "pt"),
      plot.title.position = "panel"
    )
}

save_dmr_pdf <- function(dmr_df, pheno_df) {
  grDevices::pdf(
    file.path(save_dir, "plots", "dmr_to_ptau_and_memory.pdf"),
    width = 8.5, height = 11
  )
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)

  for (first in seq.int(1L, nrow(dmr_df), by = 2L)) {
    plots <- list()
    for (i in seq.int(first, min(first + 1L, nrow(dmr_df)))) {
      dmr <- rownames(dmr_df)[i]
      scores <- dmr_df[i, ]

      # Left: residual cognition; right: pTau z-score, for the same DMR.
      plots <- c(plots, list(
        plot_dmr_scatter(
          pheno_df, scores, dmr, "resid",
          "Residual cognition vs DMR",
          "Memory score (residual; covariate-adjusted)"
        ),
        plot_dmr_scatter(
          pheno_df, scores, dmr, "Z_PTAU181",
          "pTau vs DMR", "pTau (z-score)"
        )
      ))
    }

    # If the number of DMRs is odd, leave the final page's bottom row blank.
    while (length(plots) < 4L) {
      plots[[length(plots) + 1L]] <- grid::nullGrob()
    }

    page <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
      grobs = plots,
      layout_matrix = rbind(
        c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA),
        c(NA,  1, NA,  2, NA),
        c(NA,  3, NA,  4, NA),
        c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA)
      ),
      widths = grid::unit(c(0.45, 3.75, 0.10, 3.75, 0.45), "in"),
      heights = grid::unit(c(0.8, 4.8, 4.8, 0.6), "in")
    )
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::grid.draw(page)
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}
```

## Correlation Tables

```{r func_table}
# Same Spearman tests as the scatter plots and as the CpG summaries in 05a
spearman_summary <- function(dmr_values, outcome_values) {
  keep <- stats::complete.cases(dmr_values, outcome_values)
  test <- suppressWarnings(
    stats::cor.test(
      dmr_values, outcome_values, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"
    )
  )

  list(
    n = sum(keep),
    rho = unname(as.numeric(test$estimate)),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}

get_dmr_correlations <- function(dmr_df, pheno_df) {
  plyr::ldply(seq_len(nrow(dmr_df)), function(i) {
    scores <- as.numeric(dmr_df[i, ])
    mem <- spearman_summary(scores, pheno_df$resid)
    ptau <- spearman_summary(scores, pheno_df$Z_PTAU181)

    data.frame(
      DMR = rownames(dmr_df)[i],
      n_resid = mem$n,
      spearman_rho_resid = mem$rho,
      p_resid = mem$p,
      n_pTau = ptau$n,
      spearman_rho_pTau = ptau$rho,
      p_pTau = ptau$p
    )
  })
}

# Stack the 05a CpG summaries and the DMR summaries, then apply BH FDR across
# all loci (25 CpGs + 32 DMRs), separately for memory and for pTau.
combine_and_correct <- function(dmr_cor_df) {
  cpg_cor_df <- read.csv(
    file.path(save_dir, "linear_model", "all_assoc_summaries_MCI.csv")
  ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Locus = "CpG", "n_resid", "spearman_rho_resid", "p_resid",
      "n_pTau", "spearman_rho_pTau", "p_pTau"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Type = "CpG")

  dmr_cor_df %>%
    dplyr::rename(Locus = "DMR") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Type = "DMR") %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(cpg_cor_df, .) %>%
    dplyr::relocate("Type", .after = "Locus") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fdr_resid = stats::p.adjust(.data$p_resid, method = "BH"),
      fdr_pTau = stats::p.adjust(.data$p_pTau, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::relocate("fdr_resid", .after = "p_resid")
}
```

# Run Analysis

## Load Data

```{r load}
data_ls <- get_data()

pheno_df <- data_ls$pheno_df
dmr_df <- data_ls$dmr_df
```

## Plot

```{r plot}
save_dmr_pdf(dmr_df, pheno_df)
```

## Save Correlation Tables

```{r save_tables}
dmr_cor_df <- get_dmr_correlations(dmr_df, pheno_df)
write.csv(
  dmr_cor_df,
  file = file.path(save_dir, "linear_model", "all_assoc_summaries_DMR_MCI.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

locus_cor_df <- combine_and_correct(dmr_cor_df)
cat(
  "Loci in FDR family:", nrow(locus_cor_df),
  "(", sum(locus_cor_df$Type == "CpG"), "CpGs,",
  sum(locus_cor_df$Type == "DMR"), "DMRs )\n"
)
write.csv(
  locus_cor_df,
  file = file.path(
    save_dir, "linear_model", "all_assoc_summaries_CpG_DMR_FDR_MCI.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
